nudge.title: Secure your data
nudge.promo_text: ✨ Try all of CommunityGlows, with every feature currently available, free for 30 days if your account is eligible. No card, no automatic payment. You can request up to two more 30-day periods. After your trial periods are used, access to the app pauses until you choose the €149 incl. VAT lifetime licence—one payment, no subscription. There’s no free access after the trial. I’m Diane, the independent maker behind CommunityGlows. I put my heart into it, one improvement at a time.

onboarding.language_desc: You can change this choice at any time in settings.
onboarding.welcome_desc: ✨ Bring your social profiles together and make day-to-day work across networks feel simpler.
onboarding.access_terms: If your account is eligible, a free 30-day trial starts at the first access check after sign-in. It gives you access to all of CommunityGlows, with every feature currently available; features still in development are not included yet. No card or automatic payment. You may request up to two more 30-day trial periods (90 days total). After your trial periods are used, access to the app pauses until you buy the €149 incl. VAT lifetime licence—one payment, no subscription. There is no free access after the trial. A purchased licence stays with the account used to buy it.
onboarding.access_maker_note: 💛 I’m Diane, the independent maker behind CommunityGlows. I put my heart into it, one improvement at a time, to make working across social networks feel simpler. I hope you’ll enjoy making it part of your day.
onboarding.profile_desc: Pick an emoji and a name for your profile. Your existing settings are kept. You can create more profiles later.
onboarding.networks_desc: Select the networks you use. You can change this anytime.
onboarding.feature_profiles_desc: One profile per use case: personal, work, side project. Each with its own networks and isolated sessions.
onboarding.feature_customize_desc: Long-press a network on the dashboard to show or hide networks per profile. Each profile only displays what you need.
onboarding.feature_focus_desc: Switch to grayscale to reduce visual distractions.
onboarding.feature_notifications_desc: Export a copy of your profiles and preferences, then restore it when needed.
onboarding.feature_privacy_desc: Each profile keeps separate sessions to separate your sign-ins across networks.

native_guide.title: When should I use the native app?
native_guide.intro: The extension opens your networks in tabs. For the uses below, explore the Windows app on the official download page.
native_guide.workspace: The Bento workspace is available in the Windows app. Sites can refuse embedding inside an extension page; here, they open in separate tabs.
native_guide.sessions_title: Separate social sessions for each profile
native_guide.sessions: This extension uses your browser sessions. Its profiles organize your links but do not separate social logins. Use native profiles for separate sessions, then sign in to your networks in the app.
native_guide.backup: App backup import and export are not offered in this version of the extension. These commands are available in the native app; they do not automatically retrieve extension data.
